# JA4 test vectors: ClientHello handshake payloads (hex) from the pcap files
# of https://github.com/FoxIO-LLC/ja4 (pcap/), with the JA4 values of the
# reference implementation's snapshot tests (rust/ja4/src/snapshots at
# commit c6469a7). Format: pcap SNI JA4 payload-hex
# tls-non-ascii-alpn.pcapng is the exception. Its first ALPN value is not
# alphanumeric. The reference implementations print "99" for it, but
# technical_details/JA4.md prints the first and last hex characters, so the
# expected value here follows the specification.
